mintAuthority.summary: cUSDO has native wrapper issuance on Ethereum and direct Token-2022 issuance on Solana; Base and BSC cUSDO are ERC-4626 wrappers over local USDO CCIP representations rather than independent native cUSDO liabilities. The Base/BSC CCIP pools and representation-token administration are scored in Bridge Risk, while base USDO issuance remains inherited from usdo-openeden. Solana's direct Token-2022 signer has no configured on-chain supply ceiling, so the corrected native posture is unbounded but reconciled and supervised.

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO Ethereum ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.capDescription: cUSDO shares are minted/burned by the OpenEden ERC-4626-style wrapper against USDO wrap/unwrap; this share accounting cannot create or destroy base USDO supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25535942, asset() returned USDO 0x8238884ec9668ef77b90c6dff4d1a9f4f4823bfe; the ERC-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xb9413a34f68072a362b6a58f46c6af36c4e5d890 and the transparent-admin slot was zero. The verified implementation exposes ERC-4626 deposit/mint against USDO, not issuer-only base-USDO minting.

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO EVM UPGRADE_ROLE admin EOA
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770557, this no-bytecode EOA held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADE_ROLE, and PAUSE_ROLE on the Ethereum cUSDO wrapper. Verified cUSDO source makes UUPS _authorizeUpgrade() require UPGRADE_ROLE; no timelock was observed. Base/BSC representation-token role observations are retained under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: cUSDO Solana Token-2022 mint and freeze authority
controls.capDescription: At finalized Solana slot 439726534, the Token-2022 mint has no configured supply ceiling; the direct system-account mint authority can issue arbitrary cUSDO at the token layer. Reserve reconciliation and prudential supervision do not create an on-chain cap.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 439726534, the Token-2022 cUSDO mint BnANu5CtUogLqcvBNByJuwaRvRxNtVuDcAytwjsUUtqs returned FPyi9yJKNX8y5gkadeFvbC2pDB9VVqxpwfofHxJ6Ed7i as mintAuthority, freezeAuthority, transfer-hook authority, metadata pointer authority, and metadata update authority. The key is a non-executable System Program account, and the mint has no configured supply ceiling.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770557, the Ethereum cUSDO deployment resolved through a zero-admin-slot EIP-1967 proxy to implementation 0xb9413a34f68072a362b6a58f46c6af36c4e5d890; the no-bytecode EOA held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADE_ROLE, and PAUSE_ROLE, and verified source makes UUPS upgrades depend on UPGRADE_ROLE with no timelock. The Base and BSC cUSDO deployments are ERC-4626 wrappers over local USDO bridge representations; their wrapper role and upgrade observations are scored in Bridge Risk, while base-USDO issuance remains inherited from usdo-openeden. At finalized Solana slot 439726534, cUSDO's Token-2022 mint and freeze authority was the direct system-account signer FPyi9yJKNX8y5gkadeFvbC2pDB9VVqxpwfofHxJ6Ed7i, with no configured token supply ceiling, so the Solana native path is economically unbounded. Reserve reconciliation: cUSDO is a wrapped form of USDO, and OpenEden's transparency materials describe Chainlink Proof of Reserve as an independent, real-time verification feed for USDO reserve coverage; this is recurring third-party reconciliation rather than issuer-only reporting. Prudential supervision: the Bermuda Monetary Authority registry lists OpenEden Digital Limited (registration number 202403468) with a Class F digital-asset-business licence effective 2026-05-26, matching the legal entity identified for the USDO/cUSDO product. Reviewed 2026-08-16. Economic-control adjudication (2026-08-16): Ethereum wrapper shares remain deposit-bounded and base USDO issuance is inherited; the authored Solana Token-2022 mint has direct uncapped issuance, so aggregate economic semantics are unbounded-reconciled. M-1 evidence review 2026-08-08: supervision 'prudential' upgraded to primary evidence - BMA register entry read directly (OpenEden Digital Limited, Class F, reg. 202403468, effective 2026-05-26; previously a time-limited Class M expiring 2026-03-31, with an unverifiable ~8-week register gap before Class F took effect) under the DABA prudential regime (BR 98/2018: audited financial statements, business plan, compliance certificate). Reconciliation downgraded continuous -> periodic: no issuer artefact names a reconciliation series; the only named series is the Chainlink usdo-por feed with a daily 86400s heartbeat and porAuditor 'Cross-chain' (no accounting firm), whose declared scope (U.S. Treasury bills only) and value (24,718,359.89 on 2026-08-08) diverge ~9% from the issuer API's full-basket figure (27,161,572.74 incl. RLUSD/USDC/BUIDL/VBILL); the docs transparency page is 7 months stale and still future-tense about a public dashboard.
